title: Lebanon president says Israeli detonations 'direct threat' to Israel deal
english: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun has condemned recent Israeli military explosions near the historic Beaufort castle, labeling them a serious danger to the existing diplomatic framework agreement. He warned that these actions represent a dangerous escalation that undermines upcoming peace talks scheduled to take place in Rome. According to the president, this move sends a harmful signal during a delicate time for negotiations between the two nations.

title: UK foreign secretary Miliband welcomes Hamas disarmament announcement
english: British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband has expressed his support for the recent agreement regarding the disarmament of Hamas. He emphasized that the priority should now be the complete execution of a 20-point peace plan. This strategy requires all sides to adhere to the ceasefire while ensuring the Israeli military exits the Gaza Strip.

title: Full text: 15-point draft peace plan between Hamas and Israel in Gaza
english: Hamas has officially accepted a 15-point peace proposal backed by the U.S. to end the conflict in Gaza. This agreement focuses on humanitarian aid, reconstruction, and establishing a new governing framework for the region. As part of the deal, Hamas will surrender its weapons, allowing for the eventual withdrawal of Israeli forces.

title: Full text: 15-point draft peace plan between Hamas and Israel in Gaza
english: Hamas has officially accepted a 15-point peace proposal backed by the U.S. to end the conflict in Gaza. The agreement outlines a roadmap for a total Israeli military withdrawal, the disarmament of Hamas, and a transition toward Palestinian governance and reconstruction. This plan, supported by international resolutions, aims to stabilize the region and establish a long-term path for Palestinian self-determination.

title: Hundreds escape Greek wildfire by sea as blazes continue across Europe
english: Hundreds of tourists and residents are being evacuated by sea from coastal towns in central Greece as powerful wildfires spread rapidly due to high winds. These incidents are part of a broader crisis affecting several European nations, where intense heatwaves and dry conditions have fueled destructive fires across the continent. While many of these blazes are triggered by human activity, climate change is increasingly creating environments that allow fires to ignite and grow more easily.

title: Chelsea fined $13.5m for FA breaches, avoid Premier League points deduction
english: Chelsea Football Club has been ordered to pay a $13.5 million fine by the English Football Association for historical regulation violations. These rule breaches, which involved third-party dealings, were voluntarily disclosed by the club’s new ownership following their 2022 acquisition. Although the team avoided a points deduction after a successful appeal, they remain under a suspended transfer ban until mid-2027.
amharic: የቼልሲ እግር ኳስ ክለብ ከዚህ ቀደም በፈጸማቸው የደንብ ጥሰቶች ምክንያት በእንግሊዝ እግር ኳስ ማህበር የ13.5 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ቅጣት ተጥሎበታል። እነዚህ ጥሰቶች በ2022 ክለቡ በአዲሱ ባለቤቶች ከተገዛ በኋላ በራሱ ፍቃድ ለሚመለከታቸው አካላት የተገለጹ ናቸው። ክለቡ ይግባኝ በመጠየቁ ከሊጉ የነጥብ ቅነሳ ቅጣቱን ማምለጥ ቢችልም፣ እስከ ሰኔ 2027 ድረስ የሚቆይ የታገደ የተጫዋቾች ዝውውር እገዳ ተጥሎበታል።

title: Russia and Ukraine report casualties as they continue to trade attacks
english: Ongoing conflict between Russia and Ukraine has resulted in multiple casualties following a series of mutual air and drone strikes. Ukraine is specifically targeting Russian energy infrastructure and logistics centers to disrupt the country's war efforts and cause fuel shortages. Meanwhile, Russian forces continue to bombard various Ukrainian districts, causing death and injury among civilians.

title: Turkiye’s Davutoglu steps back from politics: A timeline of his career
english: Former Turkish Prime Minister Ahmet Davutoglu has officially announced his retirement from politics and the dissolution of his Future Party. He cited a deteriorating political environment, characterized by corruption and a lack of accountability, as the primary reason for his departure. Davutoglu criticized the 2018 shift to a presidential system, arguing that it weakened democratic checks and fostered authoritarianism.
amharic: የቱርክ የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አህመት ዳвутኦግሉ ከፖለቲካዊ ህይወታቸው ጡረታ መውጣታቸውን እና የመሰረቱትን የወደፊት ፓርቲ መበተኑን አስታውቀዋል። ይህን ውሳኔ የወሰኑት በሀገሪቱ ውስጥ የተስፋፋው የሙስና ችግር እና የተጠያቂነት መጥፋት የፖለቲካ ምህዳሩን በመበከሉ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ዳвутኦግሉ በ2018 የተደረገው የፕሬዝዳንታዊ ስርዓት ሽግግር ዲሞክራሲያዊ ቁጥጥርን በማዳከም አምባገነናዊ አሰራርን እንዳበረታታ በመተቸት ጭምር ነው።
oromo: Muummee ministiraa Turkie kan duraanii Ahmet Davutoglu hojii siyaasaa keessaa akka of gaafatanifi Paartii Gelecek jedhamuufi ofiin dhaabbatan akka diigan beeksisaniiru. Murtee kana kan murteessan naannawa siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti malaammaltummaafi itti gaafatamummaa dhabamuun hamachaa dhufuu isaatiin akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Davutoglu sirna prezidaantummaa bara 2018 eegale kan balaaleffatan yommuu ta'u, kunis sirna dimokiraasii dadhabsiisee abbaa irrummaaf karaa baneera jedhaniiru.

title: Spain deploys military to Ceuta after migrant surge: What we know
english: Spain has sent military and police forces to the North African enclave of Ceuta following a massive influx of roughly 60,000 migrants attempting to cross from Morocco. At least 34 people have lost their lives due to drowning or injuries sustained during the chaotic border breach. This crisis has sparked significant political strain across Europe, prompting neighboring countries to consider stricter border controls and tougher migration policies.
amharic: ስፔን ከሞሮኮ ጋር በሚዋሰነው የሰሜን አፍሪካ ግዛቷ ሴኡታ፣ ከ60,000 በላይ ስደተኞች በድንገት በመግባታቸው ወታደራዊ እና የፖሊስ ሃይል አሰማርታለች። በዚህ ድንበር ተሻጋሪ እንቅስቃሴ ወቅት ቢያንስ 34 ሰዎች በባህር በመስጠም እና በመጨፍለቅ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ይህ ሁኔታ በአውሮፓ ህብረት አባል ሀገራት መካከል ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ውጥረት የፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ አጎራባች ሀገራትም የድንበር ቁጥጥርን ለማጥበቅ እየተወያዩ ይገኛል።
oromo: Spen gamoo ishee kan Afrikaa Kaabaa argamu, Ceuta keessatti godaantota gara 60,000 ta'an irraa daangaa ce'uuf yaalan to'achuuf waraana fi poolisii bobbaasteetti. Yaalii daangaa kana ce'uun walqabatee namoonni 34 ol ta'an galaana keessatti dhidhimuun ykn miidhaa qaamaa irra ga'een lubbuun darbeera. Rakkoon kun biyyoota Awurooppaa gidduutti walitti bu'iinsa siyaasaa kan uume yoo ta'u, biyyoonni ollaas daangaa isaanii cimsuuf akkasumas seerawwan godaantotaa haaraa baasuuf mari'achaa jiru.

title: Russia appears to infiltrate first ‘fortress city’ as Ukraine changes guard
english: Russian forces have reportedly infiltrated the strategic Ukrainian city of Kostiantynivka, a key defense hub in the Donetsk region. This advancement coincides with significant leadership shifts within Ukraine's military and defense ministry. Ukrainian troops on the ground describe a dire situation, noting that Russian units are encircling the area and threatening to capture the city entirely.
amharic: የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በዶኔትስክ ክልል ወሳኝ መከላከያ የሆነችውን የዩክሬኗን ኮስቲያንቲኒቭካ ከተማ መቆጣጠራቸው ተሰምቷል። ይህ የሩሲያ እንቅስቃሴ በዩክሬን የመከላከያ ሚኒስቴር እና በሠራዊቱ አመራር ውስጥ ትልቅ ለውጥ በተደረገበት ወቅት መከሰቱ ትኩረት ስቧል። በጦር ግንባር ያሉት የዩክሬን ወታደሮች የሩሲያ ወታደሮች ከተማዋን እየከበቧት በመሆኑ ሁኔታው በጣም አስጊ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni Raashiyaa magaalaa Kostiantynivka kan naannoo Donetskitti argamtuu fi iddoo tarsiimawaa taate keessa seenuun gabaasameera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe yeroo mootummaan Yukreeni hoogganoota waraanaafi ministeera ittisaa ishee jijjiiratte keessatti. Loltoonni Yukreeni naannichatti argaman akka jedhanitti, Raashiyaan magaalam tana marsuun ishee injifannoo argachuuf dhiibbaa cimaa uumuu ishee ibsaniiru.

title: Full text: 15 point draft peace plan between Hamas and Israel in Gaza
english: Hamas has officially accepted a 15-point peace proposal aimed at ending the conflict in Gaza and establishing new governance. Under this agreement, Hamas will disarm, leading to a complete withdrawal of Israeli forces from the territory. This plan also focuses on humanitarian aid, reconstruction efforts, and economic recovery for the region following months of intense negotiations.
amharic: ሃማስ በጋዛ ያለውን ግጭት ለማስቆም እና አዲስ የአስተዳደር ስርዓት ለመዘርጋት የቀረበውን የ15 ነጥብ የሰላም ስምምነት በይፋ ተቀብሏል። በዚህ ስምምነት መሰረት ሃማስ ትጥቅ የሚፈታ ሲሆን፣ ይህም የእስራኤል ጦር ከጋዛ እንዲወጣ መንገድ ይከፍታል። ስምምነቱ ለሰብአዊ እርዳታ፣ መልሶ ግንባታ እና ለክልሉ የኢኮኖሚ ማገገም ቅድሚያ የሚሰጥ ነው።
oromo: Hamaas waraana Gaazaa keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru dhaabuuf fi sirna bulchiinsa haaraa hundeessuuf waliigaltee nageenyaa qabxii 15 qabu fudhateera. Waliigaltee kanaan, Hamaas meeshaa hiikkachuun kan itti fufu yoo ta'u, kunis waraanni Israa'el naannichaa gadhiisee akka bahu ni godha. Karoorri kun gargaarsa namoomaa, ijaarsa gara fuulduraa fi deebi'anii dhaabbachuu diinagdee naannichaa irratti xiyyeeffata.

title: Ben Gvir says draft peace deal for Gaza 'unacceptable to Israel'
english: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir has officially rejected a proposed Gaza peace deal, arguing that halting the assassination of Hamas leaders would threaten Israel's security. This opposition follows criticism from Gadi Eisenkot, who questioned why the government is not transparently sharing the agreement's details with the public. Both figures have expressed concerns about the deal's potential impact on the mission to dismantle Hamas's influence in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል የሀገር ውስጥ ደህንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን ግቪር በጋዛ የቀረበውን የሰላም ስምምነት ውድቅ አድርገዋል። የሀማስ መሪዎችን መግደል ማቆም ለእስራኤል የደህንነት ስጋት ይፈጥራል በማለት ተቃውሟቸውን ገልጸዋል። በሌላ በኩል ጋዲ አይዘንኮት የተባሉ ተፅዕኖ ፈጣሪ የእስራኤል ፖለቲከኛ፣ መንግስት የሰላም ስምምነቱን ለህዝብ ግልፅ አለማድረጉ አጠያያቂ መሆኑን በመግለጽ ስጋታቸውን አጋርተዋል።
oromo: Ministirri nageenya biyyaalessaa Israa'el Itamaar Ben Gviir, waliigaltee nagaa Gaazaaf dhiyaate fudhatama akka hin qabne beeksisaniiru. Hogganoota Haamaas ajjeesuu dhaabuun nageenya Israa'el balaaf akka saaxilu dubbatu. Gamtaan, gaaffiin Gadii Aayizenkoot, mootummaan waliigaltee kana ifatti ummataaf dhiyeessuu dhabuun isaa shakkiin akka uumamu godheera jedhaniiru.

title: Gaza Board of Peace outlines latest roadmap
english: The Gaza Board of Peace has introduced a new plan calling for Israel to immediately stop all military actions as required by their October peace agreement. Under this proposal, Palestinian factions have agreed to transfer all governance and security duties to an independent National Committee for the Administration of Gaza (NCAG). The committee will be responsible for managing public services and institutions without any interference from political factions during the transition.
amharic: የጋዛ የሰላም ቦርድ እስራኤል በጥቅምት ወር በተፈረመው የሰላም ስምምነት መሰረት ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎችን በአስቸኳይ እንድታቆም የሚጠይቅ አዲስ እቅድ ይፋ አድርጓል። በዚህ እቅድ መሰረት የፍልስጤም ቡድኖች አስተዳደራዊ እና የፀጥታ ስራዎችን ለብሔራዊ የጋዛ አስተዳደር ኮሚቴ (NCAG) ለማስረከብ ተስማምተዋል። ኮሚቴው በመሸጋገሪያ ጊዜው ምንም አይነት ጣልቃ ገብነት ሳይኖር የህዝብ አገልግሎቶችን እና ተቋማትን በነጻነት የመምራት ስልጣን ይኖረዋል።
oromo: Boordiin Nagaa Gaazaas Israa'el waliigaltee nagaa baatii Onkololeessaa kanaan dura mallatteessiteen tarkaanfii waraanaa hunda yeroodhaan akka dhaabdu gaafateera. Karoora kana jalatti, gareewwan Falasxiin bulchiinsa fi nageenya hunda 'National Committee for the Administration of Gaza' (NCAG) jedhamutti dabarsuuf walii galaniiru. Komiteen kun yeroo cehumsaa keessatti giddu-galummaa siyaasaa tokko malee tajaajila uummataa fi dhaabbilee bulchuuf aangoo guutuu qabaata.

title: Israeli air strike in central Gaza kills one
english: A Palestinian individual lost their life following an Israeli military airstrike conducted in central Gaza. Medical personnel at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital confirmed the fatality. The details of the attack were reported by local media sources.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ጋዛ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት አንድ ፍልስጤማዊ ህይወቱ አልፏል። የአል-አቅሳ ሰማዕታት ሆስፒታል የህክምና ባለሙያዎች የሟቹን መረጃ አረጋግጠዋል። ጉዳዩ በአካባቢው መገናኛ ብዙሃን አማካኝነት ይፋ ሆኗል።
oromo: Gaza giddu galeessatti haleellaa xiyyaaraa Israa'el gaggeessiteen namni Falasxiin tokko lubbuun isaa darbeera. Hojjettoonni fayyaa hospitaala Al-Aqsa Martyrs du'a nama kanaa mirkaneessaniiru. Odeeffannoon kun miidiyaalee naannichaan gabaasameera.

title: North Sea oil fields set to be reopened by Burnham would profit blacklisted Israeli company
english: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham is planning to resume oil and gas drilling at the Rosebank and Jackdaw sites, despite significant criticism. Campaigners warn that this decision may violate international law because a major stakeholder, the Israeli company Delek Group, is blacklisted by the UN for its involvement in illegal West Bank settlements. Critics argue the project is ethically problematic and environmentally irresponsible, even though the move has received public support from former US President Donald Trump.
amharic: የብሪታኒያው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም ከፍተኛ ትችት ቢሰነዘርባቸውም በሮዝባንክ እና በጃክዳው ቦታዎች ላይ የነዳጅ እና የጋዝ ቁፋሮ ስራን እንደገና ለመጀመር አቅደዋል። የአይሁድ ኩባንያ የሆነው ደሌክ ግሩፕ በተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በጥቁር መዝገብ ውስጥ የገባ ኩባንያ በመሆኑ እና ህገ-ወጥ የዌስት ባንክ ሰፈራዎችን በመደገፉ ይህ ውሳኔ ዓለም አቀፍ ህግን ሊጥስ እንደሚችል አክቲቪስቶች ያስጠነቅቃሉ። ይህ ፕሮጀክት ስነ-ምግባር የጎደለው እና ለአካባቢ ጥበቃ አደገኛ እንደሆነ ቢታመንም፣ የቀድሞው የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ውሳኔውን ደግፈውታል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeeraa Biritaaniyaa Andy Burnham, komii cimaa irratti ka'u illee osoo hin jijjiiramin, lafa Roozbaankii fi Jaakdaaw jedhaman keessatti hojii qotannaa boba'aa fi gaazii deebisanii jalqabuuf karoorfachaa jiru. Dhaabbanni Israa'el 'Delek Group' jedhamu kan UN biratti seeraan ala qabamee fi qubata lafa Weest Baankii keessatti hirmaachaa jiru, gareewwan mirga namoomaa falman biratti mormii guddaa kaaseera. Hojiiwwan kunneen seera idil-addunyaa cabsuu fi miidhaa naannoo geessisuu akka danda'an kan himamu ta'us, pirezidaantiin Amerikaa duraanii Donald Trump tarkaanfii kana deggaranii jiru.

title: Peru's ex-president has 15-year jail sentence for corruption charges overturned
english: Peru's constitutional court has voided the 15-year prison sentence previously given to former president Ollanta Humala for corruption. The judges ruled that the financial contributions received for his political campaigns do not qualify as money laundering. Consequently, Humala is expected to be released from custody, as the criminal case against him has been officially dismissed.
amharic: የፔሩ ህገ-መንግስታዊ ፍርድ ቤት በቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ኦላንታ ሁማላ ላይ በሙስና ወንጀል ተጥሎ የነበረውን የ15 ዓመት እስራት ሽሯል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ለምርጫ ዘመቻ የተገኙ የገንዘብ ድጋፎች የገንዘብ ማጠብ ወንጀል እንደማይሆኑ ወስኗል። በዚህም ምክንያት የቀረበባቸው የወንጀል ክስ በመቋረጡ ሁማላ ከእስር እንደሚለቀቁ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Mana maree seera bu'uuraa biyya Peeruu, pirezidaantii duraanii Ollanta Humala irratti yakka malaammaltummaan murtaa'ee ture hujiirraa oolcheera. Abbootiin seeraa, qarshii duula filannoo isaatiif argate yakka seeraan ala qarshii qulqulleessuu hin jedhamu jechuun murteessaniiru. Kanaan walqabatee, himannaan yakkaa irratti dhiyaatee ture waan haqameef, Humala mana hidhaatii akka gadhiifamu eegama.

title: ‘Migrant tsunami’: Second day of Spain – Morocco border clashes
english: Violent confrontations have occurred for a second consecutive day at the border between Morocco and the Spanish enclave of Ceuta. This follows a massive surge in migration, with approximately 49,000 individuals entering the territory within a single day. Security forces have been significantly increased in the area to manage the ongoing crisis.
amharic: በሞሮኮ እና በስፔን የሲዩታ ድንበር አካባቢ ለሁለተኛ ተከታታይ ቀን ግጭቶች ተቀስቅሰዋል። ባለፉት ሃያ አራት ሰዓታት ውስጥ ወደ 49,000 የሚጠጉ ስደተኞች ወደ ስፔን ግዛት መግባታቸውን ተከትሎ ውጥረቱ አሁንም ቀጥሏል። አካባቢውን ለመቆጣጠር የጸጥታ ሃይሎች በስፋት ተሰማርተዋል።
oromo: daangaa biyya Morookoo fi kutaa biyya Ispeen kan Ceuta jedhamu irratti guyyaa lammataaf walitti buiinsi uumameera. Sa'aatii 24 darban keessatti godaantotni kuma 49 ol gara biyya Ispeen seenuun isaanii waldhabdee kana hammaachiiseera. Humnoonni nageenyaa haala jiru to'achuuf daangicha irratti ramadamanii jiru.

title: Russia’s Africa Corps killed Mali civilians in air strike: HRW
english: Human Rights Watch has reported that Russian paramilitary forces, known as the Africa Corps, killed eight civilians, including three children, during an airstrike in the Malian village of Kyrnia this past June. Although the Russian forces claimed they were targeting militants, the report asserts that the attack failed to strike any armed fighters and instead hit civilian areas, including a residence and a marketplace. Human Rights Watch has urged Malian authorities to conduct a thorough investigation into these actions, warning that they could constitute war crimes.
amharic: ሂዩማን ራይትስ ዎች የተባለው ተቋም የአፍሪካ ኮርፕስ የተሰኙ የሩሲያ ታጣቂዎች በሰኔ ወር በማሊ ኪርኒያ መንደር ባደረሱት የአየር ጥቃት ሶስት ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ስምንት ንጹሃን ዜጎችን መግደላቸውን አስታውቋል። የሩሲያ ታጣቂዎች ጥቃቱን ያደረሱት በአካባቢው ያሉ ታጣቂዎችን ለመምታት እንደሆነ ቢገልጹም፣ ጥቃቱ የታቀደለትን የሽብር ቡድን ሳይሆን የነዋሪዎችን ቤት እና ገበያ መምታቱን ሪፖርቱ አረጋግጧል። በድርጊቱ የጦር ወንጀል ሊፈጸም እንደሚችል የጠቆመው ተቋሙ፣ የማሊ መንግስት ጉዳዩን በአስቸኳይ እንዲመረምር ጠይቋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni mirga namoomaa Human Rights Watch, gareen waraana Ruusiyaa 'Africa Corps' jedhamu ji'a darbe baatii Waxabajjii keessa baadiyaa Maalii, biyya Kyrnia keessatti namoota nagaa saddeet, ijoollee sadii dabalatee, duula qilleensaatiin ajjeesuu isaa beeksise. Gareen Ruusiyaa kun duulli kun kan qajeele garee hidhattootaa irratti ta'uu isaa ibsatus, gabaasichi akka jedhutti duulli kun garee hidhattootaa osoo hin ta'in iddoo jireenyaa fi gabaa irratti raawwatamuun isaa ibsameera. Human Rights Watch gochi kun yakka waraana ta'uu danda'a jechuun, mootummaan Maalii qorannoo cimaa akka gaggeessu gaafateera.

title: Gaza Board of Peace announces Hamas disarmament agreement: What we know
english: Hamas has agreed to a multi-stage plan to disarm its forces in exchange for a complete Israeli military withdrawal from Gaza. This roadmap, mediated by several nations and announced by President Trump, aims to end the ongoing conflict, though Israel has yet to formally accept the terms. Significant doubts remain regarding the deal's implementation, as both sides express deep distrust and past agreements have previously failed to stop the fighting.
amharic: ሀማስ እስራኤል ከጋዛ ሙሉ በሙሉ ለቃ እንድትወጣ በሚደረግ ስምምነት መሰረት ትጥቁን ለመፍታት ተስማምቷል። ይህ በበርካታ ሀገራት አደራዳሪነት የተዘጋጀው እና በፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ይፋ የተደረገው ዕቅድ ጦርነቱን ለማቆም ያለመ ቢሆንም፣ እስራኤል እስካሁን በይፋ ስምምነቱን አልተቀበለችም። በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው ከፍተኛ አለመተማመን እና ቀደም ሲል የነበሩ የሰላም ጥረቶች መክሸፋቸው የዚህን ስምምነት ስኬታማነት አጠራጣሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Hamaas waraana Israa'el gaazaa keessaa guutummaatti akka baatuuf walii galtee meeshaa waraanaa hiikkachuu amaneera. Karoorri biyyoota hedduun walitti fidamee fi pirezidaant Traampin ifa godhame kun waraanicha dhaabsisuuf kan karoorfame ta'us, Israa'el hanga ammaatti walii galticha hin fudhatne. Walitti dhufeenya lamaan gidduu jiru keessatti amanamummaan waan hin jirreef akkasumas walii galteewwan kanaan dura turan waan hin milkoofneef, milkaa'inni karoora haaraa kanaa shakkii guddaa keessa jira.

title: Palestinians in Gaza are sceptical about the latest peace plan
english: Palestinians living in Gaza are expressing significant doubt regarding the newest peace proposal. Instead of focusing on political discussions, residents are primarily concerned with stopping the ongoing violence and receiving essential humanitarian aid. Their main priorities remain the safe return to their homes and the restoration of stability in their daily lives.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን በአዲሱ የሰላም ዕቅድ ላይ ትልቅ ጥርጣሬ አላቸው። ነዋሪዎቹ በፖለቲካዊ ድርድሮች ላይ ከማተኮር ይልቅ ዋና ትኩረታቸውን ያደረጉት ግጭቱን በማቆም ሰብዓዊ እርዳታ ማግኘት ላይ ነው። ለነሱ ቅድሚያ የሚሰጠው ጉዳይ ወደ ቤታቸው መመለስ እና በሕይወታቸው ውስጥ ሰላም እንዲሰፍን ማድረግ ነው።
oromo: Ummanni Gaza keessa jiraatu karoorri nagaa haaraan dhihaate amansiisaa akka hin taane dubbatu. Namoonni kunneen haasawa siyaasaa irratti xiyyeeffachuu irra, waraanni akka dhaabatuufi gargaarsi namoomaa hatattamaan akka isaan ga'u barbaadu. Fedhiin isaanii inni guddaan gara mana isaaniitti deebi'uufi nagaa argachuu dha.

title: Spain PM to visit Ceuta after 34 migrants die breaching border from Morocco
english: At least 34 migrants have died after a massive surge of approximately 60,000 people crossed from Morocco into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta. Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez has denounced the incident as a violation of sovereignty and is visiting the area to oversee the government's response, which includes returning thousands of individuals to Morocco. Humanitarian officials report a dire situation in the city, with many migrants, including children, left without shelter following the chaotic border crossing.
amharic: ከሞሮኮ ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ በተደረገ ከፍተኛ የፍልሰተኞች እንቅስቃሴ ቢያንስ 34 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ወደ 60,000 የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ድንበር ጥሰው በመግባታቸው የስፔን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ፔድሮ ሳንቼዝ ሁኔታውን የሉዓላዊነት ጥሰት በማለት በመፈረጅ በአካባቢው እየተካሄደ ያለውን የምላሽ ስራ ለመከታተል ተጉዘዋል። መንግስት በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ወደ ሞሮኮ የመመለስ ስራ እየሰራ ሲሆን፣ በከተማዋ ያለው የሰብአዊ ሁኔታ በጣም አሳሳቢ መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Godina Si’uta kan biyya Ispeen keessatti namoonni 60,000 ol ta’an Morookoo irraa daangaa cabsuun seenuun walqabatee, namoonni 34 lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Muummeen Ministiraa Ispeen Pedro Sanchez gochichi kabaja biyyaa cabsachuu akka ta’e ibsuun, deebii mootummaan kennu hordofuuf gara naannichaa imalaniiru. Mootummaan namoota daangaa darban kumaatamaatti lakkaa’aman gara Morookootti deebisaa kan jiru yoo ta’u, namoonni baay’een bakka buufatan dhabanii haala rakkisaa keessa jiraachuu gabaasameera.

title: About 49,000 migrants enter Spanish territory of Ceuta, officials say
english: Around 49,000 migrants have arrived in the Spanish territory of Ceuta from Morocco within a single day, leading to chaotic conditions and the deployment of military forces. This massive influx includes thousands of minors, and reports indicate that at least 18 people have tragically lost their lives during the dangerous journey. The situation has strained the border region, which serves as a primary gateway for individuals attempting to reach the European Union from Africa.
amharic: በአንድ ቀን ብቻ ወደ 49,000 የሚጠጉ ስደተኞች ከሞሮኮ ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ መግባታቸው ከፍተኛ ውጥረት እና ትርምስ ፈጥሯል። ይህ እጅግ ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ያለው ስደተኛ እንቅስቃሴ በውስጡ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ህጻናትን የያዘ ሲሆን፣ በጉዞው ወቅት ቢያንስ 18 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው ማለፉ ታውቋል። ሁኔታውን ለመቆጣጠር ስፔን ወታደሮቿን ወደ አካባቢው የላከች ሲሆን፣ ይህ ክስተት በአፍሪካ እና በአውሮፓ ህብረት ድንበር ላይ ያለውን ከፍተኛ ጫና አሳይቷል።
oromo: Guyyaa tokko keessatti godaantonni 49,000 ta'an Morookoo irraa gara daangaa Ispeen kan taate Se'uutaa seenuun isaanii jeequmsa guddaa uumee jira. Godaantonni kunneen keessa ijoolleen kumaatamaan lakkaawaman kan jiran yoo ta'u, namoonni 18 ta'an ammoo daandii kana irratti lubbuun isaanii darbuun gabaafameera. Mootummaan Ispeen nageenya eegsisuuf loltoota ishee gara naannichaatti kan ergite yoo ta'u, taateen kun daangaa Afrikaa fi Awurooppaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumee jira.

title: At least 11, including children, injured in Israeli raids near Nablus
english: At least 11 Palestinians, including four children, were injured during raids by Israeli soldiers and settlers near Nablus in the occupied West Bank. The violence included the use of live ammunition, stun grenades, and tear gas, with reports of several arrests made across the region. These clashes follow heightened tensions and recent retaliatory attacks involving Israeli settlers in the town of Tal.
amharic: በተያዘው የምዕራብ ባንክ ናብሉስ አቅራቢያ በእስራኤል ወታደሮች እና ሰፋሪዎች በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ቢያንስ አራት ህጻናትን ጨምሮ 11 ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ ጥይትን፣ አስለቃሽ ጭስን እና ድምፅን የሚረብሹ ቦምቦችን ያካተተ ሲሆን በክልሉ በርካታ እስረኞች መወሰዳቸውም ተዘግቧል። ይህ ግጭት የተከሰተው በታል ከተማ በተቀሰቀሰው ከፍተኛ ውጥረት እና በቀል አዘል ጥቃቶች ሳቢያ ነው።
oromo: Naannoo Nablus, naannoo Qilleensaa weeraramee jiru keessatti waraanaa fi qonnaan bultoota Israa'el raawwatanin namoota 11 ta'an, ijoollee afur dabalatee, miidhamaniiru. Miidhaan kun dhukaasaa fi gaazii imimmaansuu fayyadamuu kan dabalatu yoo ta'u, naannichatti namoota hedduu hidhuun gabaasameera. Walitti bu'iinsi kun kan dhufe erga magaalaa Tal keessatti walitti bu'iinsa cimaa fi haaloo ba'achuuf yaalamee booda.

title: Her mother said no to a phone. Then came the Gaza genocide
english: In Gaza, 18-year-old Eman Lulu uses her phone to document the ongoing conflict, turning her device into a vital window for the world to witness life under bombardment. Although her mother previously restricted her phone usage, the war has transformed the device into a critical tool for survival and communication. Despite global debates regarding social media regulation for young people, this family's nightly routine highlights how digital access has become an essential lifeline in a war zone.

title: IRGC strikes US targets in Kuwait a day after US hits Iran: Latest events
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps recently launched a drone strike against the Ahmad Al-Jaber airbase in Kuwait, which houses U.S. military facilities. Iran stated this action was in retaliation for earlier U.S. strikes on Iranian territory, specifically targeting equipment warehouses and communication systems. Experts suggest Iran is attempting to broaden the conflict geographically to preempt further American military operations.

title: Hamas agrees to phased disarmament in Gaza
english: Hamas has officially accepted a plan to gradually give up its weapons in the Gaza Strip. This development is a core component of a broader peace proposal introduced by President Donald Trump. The U.S. leader has publicly characterized this agreement as a significant historical milestone for the region.
